items.prompt:
Which human activity can reduce biodiversity?
A) Clearing forests
B) Protecting habitats
C) Planting native species
D) Cleaning pollution

steps: Clearing forests harms species and biodiversity.

items.prompt:
A wildlife corridor is
A) a crossing that lets animals move safely across a barrier
B) a type of pollution
C) a kind of fishing net
D) a factory
items.answer: A) a crossing that lets animals move safely across a barrier

items.prompt:
Treating factory waste before it enters a river helps by
A) reducing pollution so species can recover
B) adding more pollution
C) removing the river
D) killing the fish
items.answer: A) reducing pollution so species can recover

items.prompt:
To refine a solution means to
A) improve it based on how it works
B) delete it
C) ignore the results
D) make it worse
items.answer: A) improve it based on how it works

items.prompt:
Removing a harmful invasive species from a park helps biodiversity because
A) native species can recover
B) it adds pollution
C) it removes all life
D) it builds a road

You evaluate a biodiversity solution mainly by whether it
A) reduces harm, such as species recovering
B) looks nice
C) is the most expensive
D) is the newest
items.answer: A) reduces harm, such as species recovering

steps: A good solution reduces harm to biodiversity.

items.prompt:
A full fishing ban versus a fishing limit: the ban
A) protects fish most but stops all fishing, which can hurt the community
B) always helps everyone
C) has no effect on fish
D) increases fishing
items.answer: A) protects fish most but stops all fishing, which can hurt the community

steps: A full ban trades people's needs for maximum protection.

items.prompt:
The best way to refine an expensive, hard-to-run pollution solution is to
A) find a cheaper or simpler method that still reduces the pollution
B) stop reducing pollution
C) ignore the cost
D) remove the river
items.answer: A) find a cheaper or simpler method that still reduces the pollution

steps: A more practical method that still works refines the solution.
